modules.summary: This module provides learners with the knowledge and skills required to conduct rigorous research in public administration and governance. It introduces qualitative, quantitative, and mixed-method research approaches, data collection techniques, and methods of data analysis. Learners will develop the ability to critically evaluate research literature and apply appropriate methodologies to public sector issues. The module also emphasizes research ethics, academic writing, and the preparation of research proposals and dissertations.
modules.title: Research Methods

modules.summary: This module examines the structures, processes, and practices of public administration across different countries and governance systems. It explores how political, cultural, economic, and historical factors influence public sector institutions and administrative performance. Learners will critically compare administrative models, governance approaches, and public sector reforms in both developed and developing nations. The module develops an understanding of global best practices and their application to contemporary public administration challenges.
modules.title: Comparative Public Administration

modules.summary: This module provides an understanding of the principles, structures, and functions of public health administration within local, national, and international contexts. It explores health policy development, planning, governance, resource management, and the organization of public health systems. Learners will examine the roles of public institutions in disease prevention, health promotion, and community well-being. The module also develops skills in strategic decision-making, leadership, and the effective administration of public health programs and services.
modules.title: Public Health Administration

modules.summary: This module introduces the principles and practices of Human Resource Management (HRM) in contemporary organizations. It examines key areas including workforce planning, recruitment and selection, training and development, performance management, employee relations, and compensation strategies. Learners will explore the role of HR in achieving organizational objectives and fostering a productive work environment. The module also develops practical skills in managing human capital, ensuring compliance with employment regulations, and supporting organizational growth and sustainability.
modules.title: Human Resource Management

modules.summary: This module provides a comprehensive understanding of the principles, methodologies, and tools used in effective project management. It explores key project phases, including initiation, planning, execution, monitoring, control, and project closure. Learners will develop skills in managing project scope, time, cost, quality, risks, and stakeholder expectations to achieve organizational objectives. The module also emphasizes leadership, teamwork, and decision-making techniques required for the successful delivery of projects in diverse organizational settings.
modules.title: Project Management

modules.summary: This module explores the concepts, theories, and practices of strategic leadership in dynamic organizational environments. It examines the role of leaders in developing vision, formulating strategy, driving organizational change, and fostering innovation. Learners will analyze leadership styles, decision-making processes, ethical considerations, and the management of organizational performance. The module equips students with the knowledge and skills required to lead strategically, inspire teams, and achieve sustainable organizational success in a complex and competitive landscape.
modules.title: Strategic Leadership

modules.summary: This module provides a comprehensive introduction to the principles and practices of business management in modern organizations. It examines key management functions, including planning, organizing, leading, and controlling, while exploring strategies for effective decision-making and resource utilization. Learners will develop an understanding of organizational structures, business operations, and the external factors influencing organizational performance. The module also enhances analytical, leadership, and problem-solving skills required to manage businesses effectively and achieve strategic objectives in a competitive environment.
modules.title: Business Management

modules.summary: This module provides an in-depth understanding of the management and administration of health and social care services within diverse care settings. It explores key concepts including healthcare governance, service delivery, quality assurance, workforce management, and policy implementation. Learners will examine the challenges of managing health and social care organizations while ensuring person-centered, ethical, and effective care. The module also develops leadership, strategic planning, and decision-making skills necessary for improving service outcomes and meeting the needs of individuals and communities.
modules.title: Health And Social Care Management

modules.summary: This module examines the strategic approaches to workforce resourcing, talent management, and reward systems in a global business environment. It explores key concepts such as recruitment and selection, talent acquisition and retention, performance management, employee development, and compensation strategies across international contexts. Learners will analyze how organizations attract, develop, motivate, and retain skilled employees to achieve competitive advantage. The module also develops an understanding of global workforce challenges, diversity management, and the alignment of reward practices with organizational objectives and employee performance.
modules.title: Global Resourcing Talent And Reward Management

longDescription: The EMBA in Project Management is designed for professionals seeking to enhance their strategic, leadership, and operational capabilities. The program focuses on Agile methodologies, project logistics, and information management to drive efficiency and adaptability in complex projects. Participants will learn to apply strategic financial planning, HR practices, and market-driven insights to ensure organizational success. The curriculum emphasizes innovation, team alignment, and long-term value creation. Advanced research techniques will empower students to develop data-informed solutions for project and business challenges.
courseDetails: Executive Master Of Business Administration In Project Management is organised around 12 recorded curriculum sections. The published curriculum includes ASSIGNMENT & STUDY GUIDELINES, STRATEGIC MANAGEMENT, STRATEGIC LEADERSHIP, STRATEGIC HUMAN RESOURCE MANAGEMENT, STRATEGIC MARKETING, and additional specialist or research study. Module descriptions and available lesson resources are listed in the curriculum section below.
entry: You are required to hold at minimum a recognised bachelor’s degree with a minimum overall score of 55% (GPA 2.0 on a 4.0 point scale) or higher.

In some instances, you may also require relevant work experience and/or research experience. If applicable, you may demonstrate this through the submission of a CV, portfolio, and/or a personal statement.
English Language Proficiency:
Our programs are conducted in English language. As such, you must demonstrate proficiency in English language by submitting one of the following test scores during the application process:
IELTS Overall: 5.5TOEFL (iBT: 58+; PBT: 490+; CBT: 167+)TOEIC Overall: 555+PTE Overall: 50+Duolingo Overall: 90+
English Proficiency Waivers:

The English proficiency test is not required for the following candidates:– Native English Speakers, OR;– Applicants having completed their schooling in English (i.e. High School Diploma or IB), OR;– Applicants having completed their undergraduate or graduate studies in English, OR;– 2 years of work experience in an organization where English is the primary language of communication.

description: The Executive MBA in Human Resource Management equips participants with advanced skills in leadership, strategy, and talent optimization. This program covers critical HR frameworks, decision-making models, and innovative practices for aligning HR with organizational goals. Students will gain global perspectives on talent acquisition, reward management, and employee engagement. Emphasis is placed on addressing workplace conflicts and ensuring compliance with employment laws. Participants will also develop strategic capabilities to navigate complex business environments and lead impactful organizational change.The MBA curriculum consists of at least 72 ECTS credits of postgraduate study, offered as modular fashion. MBA-candidates in the short programme complete 10 required modules/courses (60 ECTS credits), plus a final Thesis/Dissertation (12 ECTS credits) or 2 additional modules (6 ECTS credits each) all of these focused on a specific field or industry of management.

longDescription: The Executive MBA in Human Resource Management equips participants with advanced skills in leadership, strategy, and talent optimization. This program covers critical HR frameworks, decision-making models, and innovative practices for aligning HR with organizational goals. Students will gain global perspectives on talent acquisition, reward management, and employee engagement. Emphasis is placed on addressing workplace conflicts and ensuring compliance with employment laws. Participants will also develop strategic capabilities to navigate complex business environments and lead impactful organizational change.The MBA curriculum consists of at least 72 ECTS credits of postgraduate study, offered as modular fashion. MBA-candidates in the short programme complete 10 required modules/courses (60 ECTS credits), plus a final Thesis/Dissertation (12 ECTS credits) or 2 additional modules (6 ECTS credits each) all of these focused on a specific field or industry of management.
courseDetails: Executive Master Of Business Administration In Human Resource Management is organised around 12 recorded curriculum sections. The published curriculum includes ASSIGNMENT & STUDY GUIDELINES, STRATEGIC MANAGEMENT, STRATEGIC LEADERSHIP, STRATEGIC HUMAN RESOURCE MANAGEMENT, STRATEGIC FINANCIAL MANAGEMENT, and additional specialist or research study. Module descriptions and available lesson resources are listed in the curriculum section below.
entry: You are required to hold at minimum a recognised bachelor’s degree with a minimum overall score of 55% (GPA 2.0 on a 4.0 point scale) or higher.

In some instances, you may also require relevant work experience and/or research experience. If applicable, you may demonstrate this through the submission of a CV, portfolio, and/or a personal statement.
English Language Proficiency:
Our programs are conducted in English language. As such, you must demonstrate proficiency in English language by submitting one of the following test scores during the application process:
IELTS Overall: 5.5TOEFL (iBT: 58+; PBT: 490+; CBT: 167+)TOEIC Overall: 555+PTE Overall: 50+Duolingo Overall: 90+
